                if (System.getenv("CHAT_MUSIC_FE_DIR") != null) {
                    Path frontend = Path.of(System.getenv("CHAT_MUSIC_FE_DIR"));
                    if (System.getenv("CHAT_MUSIC_FE_SUITE").matches(".*(sync|release).*")) {
                        String leavePath="/api/v1/chat-rooms/"+room+"/members/me?membership_id=";
                        assertEquals(204,request(polling,"DELETE",leavePath+first.membership+"&view_session_id="+first.view,
                                token(revokedSid),null,Map.of()).statusCode());
                        assertEquals(204,request(polling,"DELETE",leavePath+second.membership+"&view_session_id="+second.view,
                                token(revokedSid),null,Map.of()).statusCode());
                        assertEquals(204,request(polling,"DELETE",leavePath+survivor.membership+"&view_session_id="+survivor.view,
                                token(survivingSid),null,Map.of()).statusCode());
                    }
                    Path fixture = evidence.resolve("music-frontend-config.json").toAbsolutePath();
                    Path result = frontend.resolve("node_modules/.tmp/"+System.getenv("CHAT_MUSIC_FE_SUITE")+"/process-result.json");
                    for (int index=1; index<=24; index++) {
                        jdbc.update("INSERT INTO music(provider,external_music_id,title,artist_name,youtube_video_id) "
                                + "VALUES ('ITUNES',? ,?,'synthetic artist','abcdefghijk')", "fe-music-"+index, "synthetic song "+index);
                        long track=jdbc.queryForObject("SELECT id FROM music WHERE external_music_id=?",Long.class,"fe-music-"+index);
                        jdbc.update("""
                                INSERT INTO music_playback_sources(music_id,youtube_video_id,channel_id,channel_kind,review_reference,
                                  reviewed_by,status,duration_millis,playback_country,verified_at,valid_until,version)
                                VALUES (?,'abcdefghijk','synthetic','ARTIST','synthetic','test','VERIFIED',120000,'KR',
                                  TIMESTAMPADD(HOUR,-1,UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)),TIMESTAMPADD(HOUR,1,UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)),1)
                                """,track);
                        String conversation="fe-music-"+index;
                        jdbc.update("INSERT INTO recommendation_sessions(user_id,region_id,trigger_type,input_type,conversation_key,status) "
                                + "VALUES (411001,?,'CHATBOT','TEXT',?,'COMPLETED')",region,conversation);
                        long rec=jdbc.queryForObject("SELECT id FROM recommendation_sessions WHERE conversation_key=?",Long.class,conversation);
                        jdbc.update("INSERT INTO recommendation_items(recommendation_session_id,music_id,rank_no) VALUES (?,?,1)",rec,track);
                    }
                    Files.writeString(fixture,json.writeValueAsString(Map.of("taskA",polling.base(),"taskB",subscribed.base(),
                            "token",token(revokedSid),"location",location(revokedSid,region),"region",region,"evidence",result.toString())));
                    boolean release=System.getenv("CHAT_MUSIC_FE_SUITE").contains("release");
                    if (release) {
                        jdbc.update("INSERT INTO users(email,password_hash,nickname,role) "
                                + "VALUES ('music-peer@fixture.test','synthetic','music peer','USER')");
                        long peer=jdbc.queryForObject("SELECT id FROM users WHERE email='music-peer@fixture.test'",Long.class);
                        String peerSid=UUID.randomUUID().toString();
                        sessions.put(peerSid,session(peerSid,peer));
                        seedBrowserSession(jdbc,peerSid,UUID.randomUUID().toString(),peer);
                        for (long song:jdbc.queryForList("SELECT id FROM music WHERE external_music_id LIKE 'fe-music-%'",Long.class)) {
                            String key="music-peer-"+song;
                            jdbc.update("INSERT INTO recommendation_sessions(user_id,region_id,trigger_type,input_type,conversation_key,status) "
                                    + "VALUES (?,?,'CHATBOT','TEXT',?,'COMPLETED')",peer,region,key);
                            long rec=jdbc.queryForObject("SELECT id FROM recommendation_sessions WHERE conversation_key=?",Long.class,key);
                            jdbc.update("INSERT INTO recommendation_items(recommendation_session_id,music_id,rank_no) VALUES (?,?,1)",rec,song);
                        }
                        var data=(com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.node.ObjectNode)json.readTree(Files.readString(fixture));
                        data.put("secondToken",token(peerSid,peer));
                        data.put("secondLocation",location(peerSid,region,peer));
                        data.put("secondUser",peer);
                        Files.writeString(fixture,json.writeValueAsString(data));
                    }
                    Process child = null;
                    try {
                        var runner=new ProcessBuilder("node","node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs","run",
                                "tests/integration/chatMusicRequest.integration.test.ts","--reporter=json",
                                "--outputFile="+evidence.resolve("music-frontend-results.json").toAbsolutePath())
                                .directory(frontend.toFile()).redirectErrorStream(true)
                                .redirectOutput(evidence.resolve("music-frontend.log").toFile());
                        runner.environment().put("CHAT_MUSIC_FE_CONFIG",fixture.toString());
                        runner.environment().put("CHAT_MUSIC_FE_SUITE",System.getenv("CHAT_MUSIC_FE_SUITE"));
                        if (release) runner.command("node","scripts/runChatMusicReleaseBrowser.mjs");
                        child=runner.start();
                        if (!child.waitFor(release ? 180 : 90,TimeUnit.SECONDS)) throw new AssertionError("frontend music deadline");
                        assertEquals(0,child.exitValue(),"inspect music-frontend.log");
                    } finally {
                        if(child!=null && child.isAlive()) {
                            child.destroy();
                            if (!child.waitFor(10,TimeUnit.SECONDS)) child.destroyForcibly();
                        }
                        Files.deleteIfExists(fixture);
                    }
                    return;
                }
